hero_kpi_rationale: The KPI 'AI Cloud Mix' is the hero because AI adoption in new chip designs is Arm's primary growth driver, with increasing NPU integration in smartphones, automotive, and IoT.

kpis.name: Part deals incluant fonctionnalités IA
kpis.explanation: Percentage of new chip designs that include AI capabilities, such as NPU cores.
kpis.description: Integrated AI in new chip designs (smartphones, auto, IoT) increases value per chip and royalty revenue.
kpis.signal: Key growth in the Arm ecosystem

kpis.name: Investissements R&D (% revenu)
kpis.explanation: Share of research and development expenses in revenue.
kpis.description: Arm invests heavily in innovation to maintain its technological leadership amid competition.
kpis.signal: High level, typical of tech leaders

kpis.name: Marge brute
kpis.explanation: Consolidated gross margin, reflecting profitability from licenses and royalties.
kpis.description: High-yield software licensing model, largely independent of physical production costs.
kpis.signal: Very high, typical of IP model

kpis.name: Marge opérationnelle
kpis.explanation: Operating profit divided by total revenue.
kpis.description: Royalty growth and controlled operating expenses improve margin.
kpis.signal: Sustained improvement due to scale leverage

kpis.name: Revenu récurrent annualisé
kpis.explanation: Annual recurring revenue from software licenses and updates.
kpis.description: Long-term license contracts ensure revenue predictability.

kpis.name: Effectif total
kpis.description: Targeted growth in R&D and AI teams to accelerate future designs.

ai_positioning.summary: Arm positions itself as a leader in chip-scale AI adoption, with growing NPU core integration in processor designs for smartphones, IoT, and automobiles. Its technology ecosystem enables rapid deployment of AI features.
evidence: 10-K MD&A confirms: 'AI demand is driving strong momentum for the Arm ecosystem' with NPUs across smartphones, automobiles, and IoT
